Reach, no register

Attention that doesn't become revenue

6 of your last 7 reels cleared 2k views on a 75.8k audience. When a reel lands, the next step is a free download or a waitlist, so nothing turns that attention into income on the day.

One date

Revenue that ends when the event does

Beyond Private Practice sold at $299 for one live date, 12 December 2025. Everyone who finds you after that date has nothing to buy until the next event.

A waitlist

Free, then straight to Neuropreneur

Someone who loves the podcast but isn't ready for a community or a retreat has nothing to say yes to in between. They join a waitlist, and you never find out who is serious.

No buyer signal

Downloads show interest, not intent

Workbooks, toolkits, a podcast guide and a mini-course all build your list. A purchase is what shows you who is ready to invest in their business.

Your content does its job. What's missing is a first purchase that pays for ads and shows you who is ready for Neuropreneur.

Questions

Before you start

Is this therapy or clinical advice?

No. It's business education: lessons, templates and planning tools for building income streams. It isn't therapy, and it isn't medical advice.

How much time does it take?

Each lesson is short, and you can watch them in any order. Go at your own pace, take breaks, come back later. You keep access.

I already took your free mini-course. Is this different?

Yes. The mini-course shows you what's possible beyond private practice. The kit gives you the planner, templates and a 90-day plan to actually start one stream.

Is it only for therapists?

No. It's built for neurodivergent entrepreneurs and anyone in a helping profession who wants income beyond 1:1 work.

What happens after the kit?

If you want to go deeper, the Beyond Private Practice intensive recording covers every stream in detail, and you can apply to join Neuropreneur.

CTA

“The Neuropreneur Starter Kit. Self-paced, $27. Tap the button below.”

Shot: to camera, cut to the planner on a phone, blue dot sticker on screen, purple caption bars.
